title: An update for the lobby swap shelf
passage:
Use the shelf by the entrance for small things. The delivery cart has to go past the long shelf; it can’t get through if shoppers are standing there. We put a named hold behind the desk until noon, or longer if the person sends us a time they can come that afternoon. I’ve put Mel’s name on one of the baskets. She asked about the one in yesterday’s photo. You can’t see its color under the towel, but that’s our only basket with handles. The desk has written down her message from this morning: “I can get there at four.”

One other thing: residents can try out items with moving parts before deciding to keep them. Turn the picture card face down for a trial. Take it away only when someone tells us they’re keeping the item. The card for the folding rack is face down. A neighbor left a note saying she’d found a rack elsewhere, but she didn’t put her name on it.
passageZh:
小物請放入口旁的架子。送貨推車必須經過長架，若有人站在那裡挑東西，推車就過不去。寫了姓名、要替人保留的物品，會在櫃檯後放到中午。如果對方傳來下午能到的時間，就再留久一點。我已把梅爾的名字標在其中一個籃子上。她問的是昨天照片裡的那個。毛巾蓋住了顏色，但那是我們唯一有提把的籃子。櫃檯記下她今天早上的留言：「我四點能到。」

還有一點：有活動零件的物品，住戶可以先試用再決定要不要留下。有人試用，就把照片卡翻到背面；只有收到有人決定留下物品的通知，才拿走卡片。摺疊架的卡片已翻到背面。有位鄰居留紙條說，她已經在別處找到一個架子，但沒有署名。
